panels.description: Total number of node pools currently tracked by the backend.

targets.expr: count(backend_nodepool_provision_state{subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Total Node Pools (Fleet)

panels.description: Terminal node pool create attempts that completed within the selected dashboard time window. Denominator for the lookback SLO panels.

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Completed Create Attempts (Window)

panels.description: Windowed Success SLO: successful terminal create attempts divided by all terminal create attempts. Target: 99%. Per Steven Clarkson's SLO definition in ARO-19995 (child of ARO-19992, comment dated 2025-09-25): "Percentage of Node Pools created in less than 15 minutes greater than 99%."

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)) * 100

count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s))

panels.title: Successful Creates (Window)

panels.description: Failed or canceled node pool create attempts that completed within the selected dashboard time window. Any non-zero value means there were unsuccessful creates in the window.

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed / Canceled Create Attempts (Window)

panels.description: Node pools deleted within the selected window, fleet-wide. Shown so a drop in Total Node Pools isn't mistaken for lost data -- deletes aren't part of the create SLO tracked by this dashboard (see the Node Pool Management SLO dashboard for delete-specific health).

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="delete", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="delete", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Node Pools Deleted (Window)

panels.description: Fraction of terminal create attempts that succeeded. Green line marks the 99% SLO target. Gaps mean no terminal attempts in that window, not 0%. Per Steven Clarkson's SLO definition in ARO-19995 (child of ARO-19992, comment dated 2025-09-25): "Percentage of Node Pools created in less than 15 minutes greater than 99%."

targets.expr:
(
  (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) or (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) * 0))
  /
  count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"})
) * 100

panels.title: Availability Over Time (Create, SLO 99%)

panels.description: Fraction of terminal create attempts that failed. Threshold line marks the 1% error budget implied by the 99% success SLO. Gaps mean no terminal attempts in that window, not 0%. Per Steven Clarkson's SLO definition in ARO-19995 (child of ARO-19992, comment dated 2025-09-25): "Percentage of Node Pools created in less than 15 minutes greater than 99%."

targets.expr:
(
  (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="failed", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) or (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) * 0))
  /
  count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"})
) * 100

panels.title: Error Rate Over Time (Create, SLO 1%)

panels.description: Fixed 30-day rolling Availability, independent of the dashboard time picker. Used as the input to the Error Budget Remaining panel.

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $slo_window_seconds)) * 100

count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $slo_window_seconds))

panels.title: Availability (30d)

panels.description: Remaining error budget against the 99% availability SLO, fixed 30-day window. 100% = no budget consumed, 0% = fully consumed. Floor-at-zero convention matches frontend-slo.json's Error Budget Remaining panel. Per Steven Clarkson's SLO definition in ARO-19995 (child of ARO-19992, comment dated 2025-09-25): "Percentage of Node Pools created in less than 15 minutes greater than 99%."

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $slo_window_seconds)) * 100

count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $slo_window_seconds))

panels.title: Error Budget Remaining (30d)

panels.description: Number of create operations stuck in a non-terminal phase (accepted, provisioning, updating, deleting) for more than 30 minutes -- double the 15 minute SLO target, used as a distinct "clearly hung" signal rather than an SLO breach line. Target: 0.

targets.expr: count((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) > 1800)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Create Operations Stuck > 30 min

panels.description: Fleet p50 create duration in minutes for successful create attempts completed within the selected window.

targets.expr: ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)

panels.title: Create Duration p50 (min)

panels.description: Fleet p95 create duration in minutes for successful create attempts completed within the selected window. SLO: p95 within 15 minutes. Per Steven Clarkson's SLO definition in ARO-19995 (child of ARO-19992, comment dated 2025-09-25): "Percentage of Node Pools created in less than 15 minutes greater than 99%."

targets.expr: ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)

panels.title: Create Duration p95 (min)

panels.description: Fleet p99 create duration in minutes for successful create attempts completed within the selected window.

targets.expr: ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)

panels.title: Create Duration p99 (min)

panels.description: Rolling 1h successful create duration percentiles. With datasource=All, each selected service-cluster datasource computes its own percentiles. Red dashed line = 15 minute p95 SLO target. Per Steven Clarkson's SLO definition in ARO-19995 (child of ARO-19992, comment dated 2025-09-25): "Percentage of Node Pools created in less than 15 minutes greater than 99%."

targets.expr: (quantile(0.50, ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < 3600)) by (cluster)) or (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) * 0)

(quantile(0.95, ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < 3600)) by (cluster)) or (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) * 0)

(quantile(0.99, ((backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} - backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) / 60) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < 3600)) by (cluster)) or (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase="succeeded", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) * 0)

panels.title: Create Duration p50/p95/p99 Over Time (Rolling 1h)

panels.description: Count of node pool creates started in the trailing 5 minutes, evaluated at each point on the graph.

targets.expr: count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} > (time() - 300)) or (count by (cluster) (backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) * 0)

panels.title: Create Attempts Started (per 5m)

panels.description: Rate of items added to the NodePool controller workqueue. Covers create, update, and delete reconciles combined (the workqueue has no operation_type label) — a broader load signal alongside the create-specific attempts panel.

targets.expr: sum by (name, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(workqueue_adds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", name=~".*NodePool.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: NodePool Controller Reconcile Rate (Traffic Proxy — All Op Types)

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend pod CPU usage as a percentage of requested CPU. The backend service processes node pool create reconciliation; sustained high usage here saturates the create journey. Inlined raw query pending a dedicated sli:backend:saturation_cpu recording rule (see frontend-slo.json for that pattern). Proposed threshold: 85%.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m])) / sum by (cluster) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", resource="cpu"}) * 100

panels.title: Backend CPU Utilization (vs request)

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend pod memory working set as a percent of request. Backend has no memory limit configured, so this compares against request instead of limit like the CPU panel does. Proposed threshold: 85%.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", container!="", container!="POD"}) / sum by (cluster) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", resource="memory"}) * 100

panels.title: Backend Memory Utilization (vs request)

panels.description: Node pool controller workqueue depth. A growing queue means the controller can't keep up with incoming work (create/update/delete combined) — a saturation signal for the component that drives node pool creation. Alert threshold: > 10 for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (name, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (workqueue_depth{namespace="aro-hcp", name=~".*NodePool.*"}))

panels.title: NodePool Controller Workqueue Depth

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend available replicas as a percent of desired. Same available/desired ratio pattern used by the frontend's ready SLI (sli:frontend:ready:ratio5m). A drop here means the controller has less capacity to process node pool creates.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="aro-hcp", deployment="aro-hcp-backend"})) / sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="aro-hcp", deployment="aro-hcp-backend"})) * 100

panels.title: Backend Replicas Available

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend container restarts in the trailing hour, fleet-wide by cluster. Any restart during an active create is worth checking -- it can silently stall or duplicate a reconcile.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*"}[1h])))

panels.title: Backend Pod Restarts (1h)

panels.description: Distribution of node pools across all provisioning states over time (fleet-wide, not create-scoped).

targets.expr: count by (phase) (backend_nodepool_provision_state == 1)

panels.title: Node Pools by Provisioning State

panels.description: Failed or canceled create attempts in the selected window, grouped by subscription. Shows as "No data" when there are zero failures, not an error.

targets.expr: count by (subscription_id) ((backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s))

panels.title: Failed / Canceled Create Attempts by Subscription (Window)

panels.description: Terminal node pool create attempts that completed within the selected dashboard time window. Shows resource ID, subscription, and terminal phase.

targets.expr: (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1) and ((time() - backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) < $__range_s)

panels.title: Terminal Create Attempts (Window)

panels.description: All active node pool create operations across the fleet. Shows resource ID, subscription, and current phase. Shows as "No data" when nothing is currently in flight, not an error.

targets.expr: backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"} == 1

panels.title: Active Create Operations (Details)

list.description: Pipe-separated subscription IDs to exclude from SLO calculations (e.g. internal/test subs)
list.label: Exclude Subscriptions
